title: sideritis incana var. arairae
intro: Sideritis incana var. arairae, commonly known as Arari or Greek ironwort, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation, due to its calming and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Arari are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are primarily phenolic compounds, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been identified in the plant's leaves.
